$description: What's machine-enforced vs. convention-only when an AI generates a PageSpec.

rawValueRestrictions.color: forbidden -- must reference a tokens/10-semantic/color.json role id
rawValueRestrictions.fontSize: forbidden -- must reference a tokens/00-foundation/typography.json scale id
rawValueRestrictions.fontWeight: forbidden -- weight is fixed per typography scale entry, not independently settable
rawValueRestrictions.fontFamily: forbidden -- must be 'sans' or 'serif' per tokens/00-foundation/typography.json
rawValueRestrictions.elevation: forbidden -- must reference a tokens/00-foundation/elevation.json shadow id

overrides.note: PageSpec instances in this design-repo carry no per-instance style/token-override field at all (see schema/pagespec.schema.json) -- styling is fully owned by the section/component contracts a node references, not by the generated instance. This section records that gap explicitly per MASTER-GUIDE.md 3.21 rather than inventing a field just to have something to validate.
